description: rampart_20x_playground demo record: identity_core, administrivia, dcom, aws_core, computing_core, git_core, compliance_core, github_core, fedramp_20x_ksi, fedramp_20x_vdr, stackarmor_vdr, vuln_mosaic and rampart_20x, plus this plugin, each pinned by the peeled commit SHA beside its tag, the plugin itself by its release tag (rampart_20x by its v0.1.0 release). Every source is a public repository, so the record needs no install credential. Three hourly schedules run: the classification mapping snapshot (minute 0, reads the local grid only), the KSI catalog (minute 17, fetches from raw.githubusercontent.com) and the vuln_mosaic refresh (minute 41, fetches public CVE data from github.com, www.cisa.gov and epss.empiricalsecurity.com). The deployment inventory is mock data; the findings are a captured snapshot of real scans of TAP itself. Okta, Duo, Teleport and highbar are deliberately absent. Login is by the local passkey that spawn-session.sh replays into the stack (req-tap-auth-passkey-dev-bootstrap), not by anything in this record.

plugins.note: Installed before aws_core: aws_core 0.8.2 requires computing-core-tap 0.10.8 or later, and each entry is installed on its own.
Installed before github_core: github_core 0.14 requires sigstore-core-tap, and each entry is installed on its own, so it must already be present.

Installed after git_core and compliance_core: each entry is installed on its own, so a sibling distribution it depends on must already be present (github_core 0.13.0 requires git-core-tap, tap-plugin-compliance-core and tap-plugin-identity-core).

Installed after compliance_core: the coverage_snapshot collector subclasses compliance_core's SearchSnapshotCollector (first shipped in v0.8.7), and the classification mapping bundle's hourly Schedule targets that collector.

The PAIN method for FedRAMP VDR (the stackArmor method). Installed after fedramp_20x_vdr, whose finding reach its runners import; it seeds the sixteen archetype nodes the pain bundle's stamps point at.
Pinned by its release tag v0.1.0 (commit 28942f2), the first release of rampart-20x-tap (2026-11-05).

Self entry: pinned to its own release tag v0.3.0. The tag is cut on the commit that carries this record, so a boot from the tag installs the plugin it was booted from (a record cannot carry the commit that introduces it; self is exempt from `commit` only when `rev` is its release tag).

steps.note: TAP admin pages and grid landing.
The dcom axis, so the `design` dimension node exists for seeded entities to carry.
aws_core's vocabulary dimension nodes only; its pages and region seed arrive when a page mounts them.
fedramp_20x_ksi's vocabulary dimension nodes only; its KSI seed and pages stay out until a page needs them, and its hourly schedule is the next step.
fedramp_20x_ksi's hourly KSI catalog Schedule (minute 17); the collector's only egress is raw.githubusercontent.com and it needs no credential.
vuln_mosaic's hourly refresh Schedule (minute 41), so the local CVE stores stay current.
The 53 timeframe rows the PAIN deadline reads.
Own GRIFT: the sixteen archetypes the program stamps point at.
This plugin's own bundles: keystone and dimensions. Last, so every dimension it references already exists.
Gives every open vulnerability-linked finding its all-null VDR max evaluation, once, after the playground's findings are seeded, so the VDR max page has evaluations to show.
